name: subscription-dashboard-task
description: PlanPilot: a subscription management dashboard (React + Express + MongoDB).
author: Shanmugam R <shanmugamrskfamily@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w shared && npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
